svg.title: Notation Meaning and convention gi, gW , gX Regulator coupling gi = β−1/2 N,p,i and the Wilson and measured position couplings used in the final comparison. Their asymptotic identification is proved; it is not a notation convention. SW , S(x, v) Wilson action and stationary residual, respectively. The latter is the vertical derivative of the local score and is not an action. The unadorned S in the predictor Fourier identities is yet another locally defined symbol. C, P Covariances, precision/comparison matrices or coefficient maps accord- ing to their declared types. In a Gaussian change of variables C0 and CV denote distinct base and varied covariances. An auxiliary nonsymmetric inverse is not itself a covariance. Ed, Nd, Fd Degree-d coefficient space, null subspace for all separated spectator tests, and physical quotient Fd = Ed/Nd. Inclusions and derivatives on these quotients are constructed and proved compatible. deg, |a| Engineering degree of a label and total engineering degree |a| = P i deg(ai) of a cluster. Polynomial position degree and field count are separately specified in the radial-jet chapter. Sn, Sχ n, μph Unselected and character-dependent separated correlations, and the full- support phase measure, so Sn = R Sχ n dμph(χ). The source often writes this measure as μ; it is distinct from the finite Wilson laws. Ω, D Selected vacuum and common invariant word domain. The native prepa- ration subscript in RealPrepΩis a source convention, not a claim that a vacuum has already been derived. Θ, GΘ, E(r) Centered degree-four physical trace label, its selected Euclidean two- point function, and the positive-time Laplace reader identified with it in the spectral argument. AG, cG The full trace amplitude is AG = 3 dimR g/π4. Other local scalar or color projection constants called cG retain their local definitions.
